title: Pin carried held-read ordering, deadline skip and unnecessary-read avoidance
outcome: Round-2 Claude review found no regression test proving the held read follows this turn's captures, zero remaining capture budget skips it, or same-claim/fenced/expired candidates issue no read. Current checkpoint uncertainty tests exercise error/omitted/absent outcomes but do not record held-read timing/counts. Add deterministic meaningful boundary coverage without real sleeps or increasing production budgets.
acceptance: Deterministic checkpoint coverage proves own end-basis/check/carried capture precedes held-claim reading, and zero remaining budget skips the read while retaining uncertainty.
Coverage proves no held read occurs for same-claim/same-fence or already-refused fenced/expired candidates.
Focused relevant tests pass on the changed input without weakening timeouts or settlement safeguards.
